# 4Sho Creative Family

> Family craft kits packed in Atlanta, Georgia, USA: frame-loom weaving, block printing, air-dry clay and paper marbling, for makers aged 6 and up with an adult. Kits only; no classes.

## Kits and prices (USD)
- Weaving kit, 2 makers: $32 — https://4shocreativefamily.com/weaving-kits.html
- Block printing kit, 4 makers: $44 — https://4shocreativefamily.com/block-printing-kits.html
- Air-dry clay kit, 4 makers: $36 — https://4shocreativefamily.com/clay-and-marbling-kits.html
- Paper marbling kit: $29 — https://4shocreativefamily.com/clay-and-marbling-kits.html
- Refill pack: $14
- Four-kit bundle: $125
